title: Wound, surgical-site and fall-related complications reported with Tumor Treating Fields in the FDA MAUDE database: code, definitions and annotations
description: Code, classification definitions, extraction rules and annotations for a narrative analysis of adverse event reports for Tumor Treating Fields devices in the US FDA MAUDE database (2012 to 2025): retrieval audit against independent openFDA search arms and the FDA bulk files, human classification with a second-rater sample, rule-based and language-model extraction of wound, surgical-site, fall and death attributes, and a secondary comparison of rule-based and language-model classification. MAUDE narratives are not redistributed; they are retrieved from openFDA by the included scripts.
